t: Scene first in place of prologue
d: Boschereccia in the rock of Cyclops. First Choir of Deity Friends of the Trojans. Second Choir of Deity favorable à Greci. Discordia, Mercury, Love.
Antro de' Ciclopi with valley where the river Aci passes. Polyphemus, Oracle.
Boschereccia on the island of Circe. Ulysses.
Circe Courtyard with Statues, two Circe bridesmaids.
Hell with elixic fields, Pluto, love.
Love in the likeness of Moro. Calipso. Cinathea.
Reggia de' Feaci, Alcino king, Chorus de' Feaci.
You lock up the room of the Sleep. Jupiter on the eagle. Mercury.
The Keeper makes the sign read.
The Adventurer has the sign read.
The scene is all heaven. Mercury. Minerva. Venus. Love. Jupiter. Choir of Deity.
